CHAPTER.VERS: Actually is heard among you fornication, and such fornication, which not even among the Gentiles, as a wife one of the father to have.
And you having been puffed up are? and not rather lamented, so that might be removed from midst of you he the work this having done?
I indeed for as being absent in the body, being present but in the spirit, already have judged as being present, him thus this having practiced,
in the name of the Lord of us Jesus Anointed (having been assembled of you and of the my spirit,) with the power of the Lord of us Jesus Anointed,
to deliver up that one to the adversary for destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
Not good the boasting of you. Not know you, that a little leaven whole the mass leavens?
Cleanse out the old leaven, that you may be new mass, as you are unleavened; even for the paschal lamb of us on behalf of us was slain, Anointed.
Therefore let us keep the feast, not with leaven old, nor with leaven of vice and wickedness, but with unleavened things of sincerity and of truth.
I wrote to you in the letter, not to be associated with fornicators.
And not altogether with the fornicators of the world this, or with the covetous ones, or extortioners, or idolaters; since you are bound indeed from the world to come out.

Now but I wrote you, not to be associated, if any one, a brother being named, may be a fornicator, or a covetous person, or an idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with the such like not even to eat;
what for to me also those without to judge? Not those within you judge?
Those but without the God will judge. Put out the evil one from of yourselves.
